title: Main Pyaasa Hoon Amma
body:
Main Pyaasa Hun Amma
ya qatile jafaa, ya hussein-e-shaheed
ya hussein, maula hussein..(2)
<<MINI>>
main pyaasa hun amma, main pyaasa hun amma..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
hai khushk gala mera..(2) aur saamne hai dariyaa, haaye
<<MINI>>
main pyaasa hun amma, main pyaasa hun amma..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Tumne toh sadaa apne
pehlu mai sulaaya hai
jab pyaas lagi mujhko
khud paani pilaya hai
<<DIVIDER>>
seh roz se ab maine..(2)
paani hi nahi dekha, haaye
2. Khanjar meri gardan par
ab shimr chalaega
<<DIVIDER>>
amma yeh samaa tumse
dekha nahi jaega
jalti hui reti par..(2)
karna hai mujhe sajdaa, haaye
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Zakhmon me mere amma
hai ret bayabaa ki
jalta hua sehra hai
saaya bhi nahin koi
<<DIVIDER>>
mai maalik e kausar hu..(2)
hai phir ye sitam kaisa, haaye
4. Ab ham nahin aayenge
zainab ko bata dena
<<DIVIDER>>
masoom sakina ko
tum paani pila dena
hargiz na pukarega..(2)
ab aap ka yeh beta, haaye
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Har haal me darya par
abbas ko jaana tha
yeh mashke sakina toh
bas ek bahaana tha
<<DIVIDER>>
dil Uska bhi jalta tha..(2)
ghazi bhi samajhta tha, haaye
6. Hamshakle payambar ne
jis dam se azaan di hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Uss dam se laeenon ne
mohlat hi nahin di hai
ab aap ki godi me..(2)
hai yaad mujhe aaya, haaye
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Bachpan se yeh aadat thi
jab pyaas mujhe lagti
bin maange hue ghazi
ley aata thaa khud paani
<<DIVIDER>>
le aae zara paani..(2)
ghazi ko sadaa dena, haaye
8. Kausar pe mera lashkar
jis waqt gaya hoga
<<DIVIDER>>
har chhota bada jaakar
baba se milaa hoga
har ek ne yeh jaakar..(2)
Unse bhi kahaa hoga, haaye
<<DIVIDER>>
9. Aye "meer takallum" ho
manzar tha bhalaa kaisa
royi jo nabi-zaadi
ek shor e qayaamat tha
<<DIVIDER>>
jab chalne lagaa khanjar..(2)
kehte hi rahe maulaa, haaye
